AUTH-001 — RESTORE OWNER-CONTROLLED GITHUB AND RENDER ACCESS

Do not modify application code.

1. Reconnect or rotate the owner-controlled GitHub App/token for:
   ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

2. Required GitHub permissions:
   - Metadata: read
   - Contents: read/write
   - Pull requests: read/write
   - Actions: read/write
   - Workflows: read/write
   - Administration/branch protection: read

3. Verify authenticated HTTP 200 access for:
   - repository metadata
   - main branch SHA
   - latest workflow runs
   - workflow run details
   - branch protection
   - pull request creation capability

4. Restore Render API access for:
   srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0

5. Verify:
   - service read
   - deployment-status read
   - deployment trigger capability
   - deployed commit read

6. Do not print any secret values.

Return only:

GITHUB_REPOSITORY_ACCESS: PASS/FAIL
GITHUB_ACTIONS_READ: PASS/FAIL
GITHUB_ACTIONS_WRITE: PASS/FAIL
PULL_REQUEST_ACCESS: PASS/FAIL
BRANCH_PROTECTION_READ: PASS/FAIL
RENDER_DEPLOYMENT_READ: PASS/FAIL
RENDER_DEPLOYMENT_WRITE: PASS/FAIL

If any item fails, provide the exact owner action required.
